sloka: फुल्लनानातरुगणं समुत्पाट्य महाबलः ।गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो हस्ताभ्यां समतोलयत् ।। ६.१०२.२९ ।।
transliteration: phullanānātarugaṇaṁ samutpāṭya mahābalaḥ ।gṛhītvā hariśārdūlo hastābhyāṁ samatolayat ।। 6.102.29 ।।

translations.english: Sushena having said so, glorious Hanuman set out to the mountain of herbs. Not able to recognise the herbs he thought over.
